factory.label: Trellis factory deployed, bound to Rhea, Ref and the oracle

vault_code.label: Vault code stored in the factory (398 KB)

create_vault.label: Vault created through the factory (5.976 NEAR deposit, no access keys)

set_policy.label: Owner signs the rules once (caps, min health factor 1.5, deleverage below 1.3)

deposit.label: Owner deposits 2.5 wNEAR into the vault

position_1.label: Agent (owner-approved plan): Supply 2 wNEAR as collateral

position_4.label: Agent (owner-approved plan): Supply 1 wNEAR as collateral

tee_fund.label: Gas money for the TEE agent's account (it holds no vault funds)

set_tee_agent.label: Owner makes the TEE wallet the vault's only agent (key generated and held in OutLayer's TEE)

auto_1.label: Agent, on its own (health factor 1.25): HF 1.247 < min 1.500; target HF after withdraw 1.130

auto_2.label: Agent, on its own (health factor 1.13): deleverage: convert withdrawn collateral to the debt token

auto_3.label: Agent, on its own (health factor 1.13): deleverage: repay debt

rogue_owner.label: Rogue agent tries to rewrite its own rules (call the owner-only set_policy) → refused: ERR_NOT_OWNER

rogue_pool.label: Rogue agent tries to swap through a pool you never allowed (pool 1) → refused: ERR_POOL_NOT_ALLOWED

rogue_borrow.label: Rogue agent tries to borrow 8 USDC, which would drop the health factor below your 1.5 floor → refused: policy_violation: min_health_factor

rogue_cap.label: Rogue agent tries to swap 3 wNEAR out of the vault at once (your per-action cap is 2) → refused: ERR_PER_ACTION_CAP
